block.gmodcraft.redstone_bridge.tooltip: Links redstone to GMod: a map door, button or trigger (Map Link tool), or a Wiremod entity.
block.gmodcraft.redstone_bridge.tooltip2: Link it with the Map Link tool (admins); Wiremod adds one port per face.
block.gmodcraft.redstone_bridge.no_wirem: This redstone bridge stays inert: the GMod server is too old for map links and has no Wiremod.
block.gmodcraft.redstone_bridge.no_link: This redstone bridge stays inert: no GMod server is linked to this Minecraft server.
block.gmodcraft.redstone_bridge.outside_: This redstone bridge stays inert: it is outside the current GMod map's area.
item.gmodcraft.gmod_prop.hint: Use on a surface to place it in GMod; sneak + use with an empty hand on a GMod prop picks one up.
gmodcraft.prop.unpaired: Props: your Minecraft player isn't paired with a GMod player
gmodcraft.prop.result.1: GMod refused: that prop isn't yours (prop protection)
gmodcraft.prop.result.2: GMod refused: you've hit the prop limit (sbox_maxprops)
gmodcraft.prop.result.3: GMod refused: that isn't a loose physics prop
gmodcraft.prop.result.4: GMod refused: the prop is welded or roped to something
gmodcraft.prop.result.5: GMod refused: prop items are off on this server
gmodcraft.prop.result.6: GMod refused: the request was malformed
gmodcraft.prop.result.7: GMod couldn't do that right now
